proposals.evidence: CDIAL 1111 āṇḍa documents aṇḍa/ā̃ṛ egg/testicle forms and states that Hindi egg forms spread into eastern languages. The survey aḍa/ãra forms are linked provisionally to this family while their exact regional transmission remains open.
